name: Helpdesk app: sidebar, header, ticket list, ticket panel, knowledge base
summary: A generator for a ticketing app: a foldable left navigation, a header with breadcrumb, search, notifications and profile menus, an overview, a sortable, filterable, paged ticket list, a create/edit form, a ticket panel with status, assignment, comments and activity, a knowledge base and a settings page, in light and dark.
capabilities: Left navigation that folds to icons, with counts
Header with breadcrumb, global search, notification feed and profile menu
Overview with count cards, status and priority bars and a recent-activity feed
Ticket table with search, three filters, sorting, paging and an empty state
Create and edit form with inline validation
Ticket panel: change status, priority and assignee, comments, activity timeline, resolve and close
Knowledge base with search, category chips and an article view
Role (requester, technician, administrator) read from a list
Mock mode so every screen can be seen before the lists exist
notes: Names, wording and the measured sizes are this project's (a 1366 px prototype at scale 1.0); a new project changes the constants at the top of the file and the tokens. Attachments need a Studio-built Form (spike S-ATT). Passed pp.py build and Microsoft's Power Fx parser; not yet opened in Studio (powerfx-validation level 3).
